scenarios.requirement: Pull every runtime image from its public registry and launch the server by immutable repository digest.
Accept through the shared endpoint, claim through API node A, complete through API node B, and describe completion through the shared endpoint.
Stop one API node while acknowledged work is open and observe useful shared-endpoint traffic through the survivor within the configured bound.
Readiness and writes fail during database loss; acknowledged state remains and completes exactly once after database recovery.

Abandon a leased workflow task, preserve the run, reclaim only after lease expiry, and complete without changing workflow input or history.
